article.en: One afternoon a girl set out from the coast in a small boat.
article.zh: 一天下午，一位姑娘乘小船从海岸出发。

article.en: She was caught in a storm.
Towards evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
article.zh: 天将黑时，小船撞上礁石，姑娘跳进了大海。

article.en: She swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
article.zh: 她在海里游了整整一夜，才游到岸边。

article.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
article.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了八英里。

article.en: Early next morning, she saw a light ahead.
article.zh: 第二天清晨，她看到前方有灯光。

article.en: The girl struggled up the cliff towards the light.
article.zh: 姑娘朝着灯光的方向，挣扎着爬上了悬崖。

article.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
article.zh: 一天后她醒来时，发现自己躺在医院里。

article.en: Nearly a week passed before she could explain what had happened.
article.zh: 差不多过了一周，她才能解释发生的一切。
